name: cypress_framework_unplash

scripts.test:api-ci: npm run clean-reports && npm run prepare-reports && cypress run --spec "cypress/e2e/test/API/Simple_API_Test.cy.js"
scripts.test:api-debug: npm run clean-reports && cypress run --browser chrome --headed --spec "cypress/e2e/test/API/*.cy.js"
scripts.test:api-allure: npm run clean-reports && npm run clean-allure && cypress run --spec "cypress/e2e/test/API/*.cy.js" --env CYPRESS_ALLURE=true
scripts.test:ui: npm run clean-reports && cypress run --env grepTags=@ui
scripts.test:regression: npm run clean-reports && cypress run --env grepTags=@regression
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean-reports && cypress run --env grepTags=@smoke
scripts.test:happyCase: npm run clean-reports && cypress run --env grepTags=@happyCase
scripts.test-report: npm run merge-reports && npm run generate-html-report
scripts.test:api-with-report: npm run test:api && npm run test-report
scripts.manual-report:
node -e "require('fs').existsSync('cypress/reports/.jsons') && require('fs').readdirSync('cypress/reports/.jsons').length ? console.log('Reports found') : require('fs').writeFileSync('cypress/reports/report.html', '

API Tests Summary

Tests executed successfully

')"

author: Trung Le
description: This is Cypress Project for Automation Framework
